notes: Pure theory paper. It assesses the theoretical uncertainty on the QCD axion relic density and zero-temperature axion mass arising from the temperature-dependent topological susceptibility chi(T) (instanton computation vs lattice QCD). It reports a factor of 2-3 uncertainty in the zero-temperature axion mass for a given relic density, and O(1) uncertainties in the free energy F_0(1.5 GeV). No experimental or observational exclusion limit on any axion/dark-matter coupling is derived; no coupling-vs-mass curve. Not a new measured limit and not an experimental sensitivity projection.
